```{r}
library(readr)
```

## Research questions

**RQ1.** Are evaluation valence and extremity associated with immediate attention, and how long do those associations persist?

**RQ2.** Does prior visibility shape who gains attention from professional criticism?

## Sample

```{r}
kable(read_csv("outputs/r/coverage.csv", show_col_types = FALSE))
```

## RQ1 · Review score and attention

```{r}
reg <- read_csv("outputs/r/RQ1_regressions.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
kable(reg[reg$model %in% c("M1_score_only", "M2_quadratic", "M3L_pretrend", "M3_quadratic_controlled"), ])
```

## Discussion

Interpret score associations alongside publication timing, album release, pre-review attention and the concentration of absolute versus proportional gains. Chart visibility and professional review language are reported as complementary outcomes.
